## What is a flexseq?

`flexseq` is a persistent sequence type.
All updates return a new object and keep the original unchanged.

```{r}
x <- flexseq(1, 2, 3)
x

x2 <- as_flexseq(letters[1:5])
x2
```

## End operations

```{r}
x3 <- push_back(x2, "f")
x3

x4 <- push_front(x3, "start")
x4
```

```{r}
peek_front(x4)
peek_back(x4)

pf <- pop_front(x4)
pf$value
pf$remaining
```

## Indexing and slicing

```{r}
x2[[3]]

x5 <- x2[c(1, 3, 5)]
x5
```

## Names

```{r}
x_named <- as_flexseq(list(a = 1, b = 2, c = 3))
x_named

x_named[["b"]]
x_named$c
```

## Transforming and combining

```{r}
x6 <- as_flexseq(4:6)
x7 <- c(x, x6)  # c() is supported for flexseq
x7

x8 <- as_flexseq(1:5)
fapply(x8, function(el) el * 10)
```

x4
